CVE-2026-137327.title: GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability ...
CVE-2026-137327.description: GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service.
